name: jejay-pi-for-each
description: A pi extension that adds a /for-$each prompt loop – and hides it from your LLM! Supports children-in-directory and line-in-files iteration. Like subagents but much simpler, sequential and with more control for the user. Instead of describing the loop to the agent, just make a loop.
